integrity.computations: Standalone Python checker uses Fraction arithmetic and agrees with the integer-matrix recurrence on 65,535 positive indices.
integrity.definitions: Correlation and Fourier transform are normalized as in the explicit proof.
integrity.proof: Two exact integral child matrices establish parity rigidity in every binary shell.
integrity.scientific_provenance: Original Fourier-recursion and Riesz-product formulas attributed to the cited 2008 paper; no claim of independent external certification.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns standard balanced two-point correlations and integer Fourier frequencies, not arbitrary weights or finite-word aperiodic correlations.
A plausible 1990 autocorrelation paper was available only at abstract level; equivalent earlier coverage remains a residual risk.
The executable exact checks are finite; the universal proof is the integral parity induction.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact Fourier zeros and dyadic valuations for Thue–Morse diffraction
